items.text: We used to spend our evenings chasing abandoned carts by hand. They connected everything to our Shopify and Klaviyo in two weeks, and the follow-ups now run on their own — we've recovered nearly 18% of revenue on that channel.
items.name: Camille Fontaine

items.text: My real problem was missing requests over the weekend. Their chatbot handles most of the routine questions and only escalates the serious ones to me. My average response time went from a few hours to a few minutes.
items.name: Karim Benali

items.text: Entering supplier invoices used to take me two full days a month. Now they're read, filed and reconciled automatically in our accounting tool. I was skeptical at first, but it genuinely holds up.
items.name: Élodie Mercier

items.text: What I appreciated is that they didn't show up with some over-engineered machine. They targeted three specific tasks that were eating our time, and that was it. My team finally has room for the rest.
items.name: Thomas Rieu

items.text: Before, one lead in three slipped through because we followed up on instinct. Now every prospect has its own sequence in HubSpot and nothing gets lost. We closed two accounts we'd honestly have forgotten about.
items.name: Sarah Lévy

items.text: We'd been promised the moon elsewhere and ended up disappointed. They started with a clear, costed audit, then delivered in stages. Three months in, the ROI is real — and the numbers aren't inflated.
items.name: Antoine Mercadier

items.text: Our reps were spending way too long qualifying leads that weren't a fit. An AI agent now does the first pass and only sends them warm prospects, with the context attached. They handle nearly three times more meetings that actually matter.
items.name: Inès Khelifi

items.text: On the technical side, I was worried we'd inherit a black box. It's the opposite — everything is documented, the n8n workflows are clean, and my developers were able to take over without any trouble.
items.name: Julien Roux

items.text: We were sending the same newsletter to our entire list. They segmented it and automated the journeys based on how subscribers actually behave. Open rates jumped, and best of all we're selling while we sleep.
items.name: Margaux Lefèvre

items.question: How long before seeing the first results?
items.answer: The flash audit takes a few days. Your V1 is then revealed to you live, with your quote. Once your software is in production, the ROI cockpit in your client space measures the hours freed from the very first weeks.

items.question: Subscription or one-shot: which to choose?
items.answer: The subscription if you want your software hosted, maintained and improved every month, with measured ROI. One-shot if you have a team to take it over: we deliver everything, with a 60-day warranty. You can switch to the subscription later.

items.question: What is a star?
items.answer: A prepaid unit of work, calibrated on half a day of development. Every improvement has a fixed price in stars, known before you activate it. The subscription credits 10 a month, valid the following month too; extra stars you buy are valid for 12 months.

items.question: What automations do you offer specifically?
items.answer: We automate your emails and customer responses, lead generation and qualification, 24/7 support chatbots, CRM synchronization, social media posting, document and invoice processing, real-time reporting, and even your recruitment process. All our solutions adapt to your current tools.

items.question: How do you guarantee the security of our data?
items.answer: We use minimal access through OAuth, never store your passwords, and every key is encrypted. With the subscription, your software is hosted in Europe and we act as a processor under the GDPR, with a data processing agreement. The ROI cockpit receives no personal data.

items.question: Do you work with our industry?
items.answer: Our solutions adapt to all sectors: e-commerce, B2B services, marketing agencies, SaaS, consulting firms, industry, healthcare, etc. Each automation is customized according to your business and specific processes. We analyze your unique needs during the audit.

items.question: What is your pricing model?
items.answer: It all starts with the flash audit: €1,490 excl. VAT, deducted from your V1 if you sign within 14 days. Your V1 is a fixed price, set out in an interactive quote. Then two choices: the subscription at €1,790 excl. VAT per month (hosting, maintenance, ROI cockpit and 10 stars a month to improve your software; 3 months minimum, then no commitment), or one-shot: we deliver everything to you, with a 60-day warranty.

items.question: What support do you provide after implementation?
items.answer: With the subscription, fixes are included and tracked in your client space: handled within 4 working hours for a critical incident, 1 working day for a major defect, 3 working days for a minor one. You report a problem from your software itself, in writing, by voice note or with a screenshot.

items.question: What happens if we want to end the collaboration?
items.answer: After the first 3 months, the subscription can be cancelled with one month's notice. Reversibility is free: source code, data, documentation and access are handed over, and your purchased stars that are still unspent are refunded. You can also switch to maintenance only (€390 excl. VAT per month) instead of leaving.

items.question: Do you need to access our internal systems?
items.answer: We only request the minimum permissions needed via OAuth (like Google or Microsoft). You keep full control and can revoke all access instantly from your tools. We install nothing without your agreement.
